evidence_timeline.summary: We report near-infrared YJHs-band photometry of the very nearby Type Ia-CSM supernova SN 2026sqf in NGC 3310, obtained with the MDM InfraRed Astronomy InGaAs Experiment (MIRAGE) instrument on the MDM 1.3-m telescope. MIRAGE is a new robotic YJHs InGaAs imager in routine operations since March 2026 (Ibrahim & De 2026). The observations were carried out on UT 2026 September 20 (MJD 61303.52). We measure magnitudes of Y = 12.122 ± 0.002 AB mag, J = 11.448 ± 0.002 Vega mag, and H = 10.898 ± 0.003 Vega mag. We encourage continued multi-wavelength follow-up observations, particularly infrared spectroscopy to characterize the possible circumstellar dust emission. Further MIRAGE monitoring of SN2026sqf is planned.

publications.abstract: We report near-infrared YJHs-band photometry of the very nearby Type Ia-CSM supernova SN 2026sqf in NGC 3310, obtained with the MDM InfraRed Astronomy InGaAs Experiment (MIRAGE) instrument on the MDM 1.3-m telescope. MIRAGE is a new robotic YJHs InGaAs imager in routine operations since March 2026 (Ibrahim & De 2026). The observations were carried out on UT 2026 September 20 (MJD 61303.52). We measure magnitudes of Y = 12.122 ± 0.002 AB mag, J = 11.448 ± 0.002 Vega mag, and H = 10.898 ± 0.003 Vega mag. We encourage continued multi-wavelength follow-up observations, particularly infrared spectroscopy to characterize the possible circumstellar dust emission. Further MIRAGE monitoring of SN2026sqf is planned.

publications.abstract: We reclassify SN 2026sqf as a Type Ia-CSM SN, affirming the original proposal by Midavaine et al. (AstroNote 2026-230). Our NOT/ALFOSC spectra reveal features characteristic of Type Ia SNe (Fe III & Si II; v ~ 10,000 km/s) superimposed upon a blue continuum with strong, narrow Balmer emission. Given the low inferred rates of Type Ia-CSM SNe, one is expected at the distance of SN 2026sqf (D=17.8 Mpc) well less than once in a century.
